parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
The maximum useful output power P of a car travelling on a horizontal road is given by
P = v^{3}b
where v is the maximum speed of the car and b is a constant.
For the car,
P = 84 kW ± 5%
and b = 0.56 ± 7% in SI units.
